item.text:
For a partial-year HVAC outage of **n days**, ResStock randomly selects a start date within the location’s **Building America heating or cooling months**, as appropriate. It uses **`building_id` as the random seed**, making the selection reproducible. The outage can extend beyond the season.

Where no corresponding Building America months exist, the assumed seasons are:

- **Heating:** December–February.
- **Cooling:** June–August.

See §8.4.7, “Unavailable HVAC Periods,” p. 153 of the [ResStock 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=175).
